development.historical_exposure: The source crops were used by earlier project experiments and are development-only; they are never described as a fresh holdout.

holdout.source: Urban100 images 081-100 from the recorded public mirror
holdout.gating: Download and evaluation are forbidden until locked_model.json exists.

fusion.architecture: global nonnegative simplex weights over parallel full-image operators
fusion.fidelity: Monte-Carlo SURE for known AWGN; one fixed Rademacher probe per image
fusion.objective_scaling: SURE divided by sigma^2 so fidelity and standardized IQA terms have auditable dimensionless scales

evaluation.selection_metric: validation mean PSNR; SSIM and MUSIQ are secondary
